newsitem.title: USA: Saliva Diagnostics names top officer.
newsitem.headline: Saliva Diagnostics names top officer.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc said Thursday it named Dr. Paul Slowey to the newly-created position of chief operating officer and vice president of sales and marketing.
Slowey previously was director of sales and marketing.
Separately, the company said a jury last week found in favor of a former employee, Luc Hardy, who sued the company on charges of wrongful termination.

The jury verdict awarded the plaintiff $200,000 in damages for termination, plus $540,923 for breach of an "implied contract" and a bonus of 50,000 shares of the company's common stock and other unawarded stock options.
Saliva Diagnostics said it intends to immediately file a motion to set aside the verdict, which it believes is not supported by the evidence that was introduced at trial.
